title: Exact F2 Chain Complex Parity Obstruction for Antiferromagnetic Spin Triangle

claim_hygiene.what_it_supports: Shows that on the discrete triangle 1-skeleton over F2, non-zero curl d1*c = 1 mod 2 prevents uniform antiferromagnetic satisfaction by exact chain nilpotence d1*d0 = 0 mod 2.
claim_hygiene.what_it_does_not_support: Does not establish quantum spin-1/2 dynamics, Pauli operator algebra, continuous field theories, or macroscopic spin glass thermodynamics.
claim_hygiene.narrowest_defensible_claim: The constant-1 cochain is not an exact coboundary in C1(K; F2) because d1(1,1,1) != 0, forcing every vertex spin assignment to leave at least one frustrated bond.
claim_hygiene.next_test_needed: Test larger multi-loop kagome and triangular planar lattices with first Betti number >= 2.
